visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a high-angle shot from a luxury terrace. In the foreground, a round table is elegantly set with a white tablecloth, orange and green tinted glasses, white plates, and neatly folded napkins. A small ceramic pot with vibrant red flowers and silver salt/pepper shakers sits at the center. The background reveals a breathtaking panoramic view of a coastal bay with turquoise water, several white yachts, and lush green hillsides dotted with Mediterranean architecture under a clear blue sky. (2) The camera pans smoothly across the terrace, revealing other guests seated at similar white-clothed tables under a large beige awning. The lighting is bright, natural daylight, casting soft shadows. The architecture features wrought iron railings and stone tiling. (3) A cut transitions to an elevated view looking down at a tiered resort level featuring an elongated infinity pool. The pool area is lined with numerous red-and-white striped umbrellas and wooden lounge chairs where people are swimming or relaxing. The setting is surrounded by dense green trees and overlooks a harbor filled with large luxury yachts and speedboats. (4) A woman with long braided hair, wearing a white sleeveless dress and a black sun hat, is filmed from behind and the side as she descends a set of stone stairs bordered by a dark metal fence. She briefly adjusts her hat and sunglasses, looking out toward the scenic bay. The background remains the bright, sunny Portofino coastline.
